description: Captions a local video or audio file with the Cuecaps studio's renderer in headless Chrome or Edge and writes <name>.captions.<ext> next to it, never replacing a file: an MP4 with the captions burned in, a transparent MOV or WebM overlay, or SRT or VTT subtitles. Returns the file, its duration in seconds, the engine, the cloud minutes used and a studio link to fine-tune words and style. Needs a Creator or Pro key; 1440p and 4K need Pro. Transcription works as in transcribe, and the video never leaves this machine. Use transcribe when only the words are needed, and studio_link when the user wants to edit by hand or has no key.

aspect.description: Frame shape: 9:16 for TikTok, Shorts and Reels, 1:1 or 4:5 for feed posts, 16:9 for YouTube.

engine.description: cloud: ElevenLabs Scribe on the plan's cloud minutes, strongest on music, accents and 90+ languages; the default when the minutes left cover the file. device: on-device Whisper, no minutes; the first run downloads the model (132 MB).

keyterms.description: Names and words for cloud transcription to spell your way.

lang.description: The spoken language. Give it for any video that isn't in English; auto lets cloud transcription detect it.

out_path.description: Absolute path to write to instead of <name>.captions.<ext> next to the input, ending in .mp4, .mov, .webm, .srt or .vtt; its extension sets output. An existing file is never replaced: -2, -3 and so on go before the extension.

output.description: mp4 with the captions burned in, mov or webm as a transparent captions-only overlay, or srt or vtt subtitles. Defaults to out_path's extension when out_path is given, else mp4.

path.description: Absolute path to the video or audio file: MP4, MOV, WebM, MP3, WAV, M4A or another format the studio opens.

position.description: Where the captions sit in the frame.

resolution.description: Short side of the video. 1440p and 4k come with Pro.

style.description: Caption style. list_styles shows how each one looks.

words.description: Words per caption; 1 shows one word at a time.

name: caption_video
